token.label: API Token
token.description: Generate it in AITable under My Settings → Developer.

apiTableUrl.label: Instance URL
apiTableUrl.description: The host of your AITable instance, such as aitable.ai. Keep the default unless you self-host AITable.

apitable_create_record.label: Create Record
apitable_create_record.description: Creates a new record in a datasheet.

space_id.label: Space
space_id.description: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Values for the new record, by field name, such as {"Name": "Write docs"}. Blank fields are left empty.

apitable_update_record.label: Update Record
apitable_update_record.description: Updates an existing record in a datasheet.

space_id.label: Space
space_id.description: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: Map it from a trigger or a Find Records step.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: New values by field name. Blank fields keep their value; unticked checkboxes are cleared.

apitable_find_record.label: Find Records

space_id.label: Space
space_id.description: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.

filter.label: Filter Formula
filter.description: Only records where this formula is true are returned.

recordIds.label: Record IDs
recordIds.description: Only return these records. Empty: search all.

fieldNames.label: Fields to Return
fieldNames.description: Field names to include. Empty: every field.

maxRecords.label: Max Records
maxRecords.description: Caps matching records before paging. Empty: no cap.

pageNum.label: Page Number
pageNum.description: Which page to return, starting at 1.

apitable_find_record.beforeRequest: const blank = (v) => v === undefined || v === null || v === ''; const list = (v) => { if (blank(v)) return ''; const a = typeof v === 'string' ? JSON.parse(v) : v; return Array.isArray(a) ? a.join(',') : String(a); }; const q = { pageSize: blank(inputs.pageSize) ? 100 : inputs.pageSize, pageNum: blank(inputs.pageNum) ? 1 : inputs.pageNum, recordIds: list(inputs.recordIds), fieldNames: list(inputs.fieldNames), maxRecords: inputs.maxRecords, filterByFormula: inputs.filter }; request.query = {}; for (const k in q) if (!blank(q[k])) request.query[k] = q[k].toString(); return request;

apitable_delete_record.label: Delete Record
apitable_delete_record.description: Deletes one or more records from a datasheet.

space_id.label: Space
space_id.description: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.

recordIds.label: Record IDs
recordIds.description: The IDs of the records to delete.

apitable_delete_record.beforeRequest: const ids = JSON.parse(inputs.recordIds); request.query = { recordIds: (Array.isArray(ids) ? ids : [ids]).join(',') }; return request;

space_id.description: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.
